_comment: Claude API rates in USD per million tokens. Used only to estimate what locally-offloaded tokens would have cost had they gone to Claude. Copy this file to %LOCALAPPDATA%/fuel/pricing.json to override without a release.
_tenants: Counterfactual model per tenant id (see tenants.json): what these tokens would have cost had they gone to Claude. WEYLD's DJ really was billed to claude-sonnet-5 on 2026-08-13, so that is its honest baseline. null = no Claude counterfactual (embeddings), counted at $0. Tenants not listed use `default`.
